producer_report.summary: Closed the two gaps from job 20261014-174815-7bf8. (1) The verifier prompt now says to read any document the request cites (file or section), compare the change with it, and treat falling short as a request_reading_mismatch. This is prose-only and recorded as such. (2) `judge()` in verify.rs now takes the requirements map text at the base and at the candidate. For each row that is Covered at the candidate but was not Covered at the base (moved to Covered, or added Covered), it adds an Athena-sourced major finding and a reason naming the row ID, so the final verdict cannot be pass. Rows that stay Covered or move away add nothing. run.rs reads the map from the verifier snapshot (HEAD~1 and HEAD) through the existing `show_file`. The small row parser is duplicated in athena-core, because core cannot call the CLI's. The producer prompt states the rule. A9-1 and A10-1 are back to Partial with reasons. The strategy view G5 counts and the total are now 2/8/4 and 20/68/40. Docs added: decision D94 with alternatives and tradeoff, enforcement row M32 plus a prose-only bullet, a changelog entry, and a note in roles-and-ladder.md. The prompts hit the token budgets, so I paid with trims to existing wording instead of raising budgets.

open_issues: The map row parser now exists twice (athena-cli strategy::parse_map and athena-core verify.rs). A change to the row format must change both. A shared parser in athena-data would remove the duplicate.
The document-comparison rule is prose only. Nothing checks that the verifier actually read the cited document.
A9-1 stays Partial until the steward calls a model, and A10-1 until cost and yield tracking, reshaping and retiring are built. Neither is built here.

The deliverables list names files I did not need to touch (budgets.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, athena-core/src/lib.rs, athena-git/src/lib.rs, athena-cli/src/strategy.rs). None changed, so the budget limits stay as they were.
mistakes: I first condensed a verifier bullet that a test requires verbatim, and the workspace test caught it. I restored the original wording and trimmed elsewhere.
A first draft of the D94 text had a typo ('A and A10-1'); I fixed it.
learnings: The role-set token budgets (producer 1100, verifier 1300) are tight enough that any added prose must be paid for by trimming. The study capability's sets sit at 1097/1100 and 1298/1300.

A test in athena-context/src/lib.rs requires exact phrases in the verifier frame (for example 'a snapshot, not the real repository' and 'say so explicitly in evidence and findings'), so those bullets cannot be reworded.
docs/enforcement.md rows must name real tests; a test checks that the named tests exist.
The verifier snapshot is two commits, so HEAD~1 is the base and HEAD is the candidate; GitClient::show_file(treeish, path) reads a file at either.
The strategy-view test computes counts from the map and compares them with the 'Coverage at a glance' table, so the table and goal lists had to be edited together.
desires: A way to read saved tool output inside the working directory, so I could confirm the workspace test summary and not only its exit status.
